---
name: Documentation correction
about: Something in the guidance is wrong, unclear or out of date
title: "[docs] "
labels: documentation
---

**Which document needs updating?** (path, and the line or heading)

**What is incorrect or unclear?**

**What authoritative source supports the correction?** (law, standard, regulator or provider documentation, with the edition or date). Corrections without a source may be held until one is found.

**Review label:** a proposal starts as a **community draft** (see `docs/review-labels.md`). Passing CI or maintainer approval does not imply legal or specialist approval.

**Does it affect safety or legal accuracy?** If following the current text could weaken security or lead to unlawful handling of personal data, say so. If it is exploitable, report privately instead (see `SECURITY.md`).
